verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Zechariah 1

Zechariah's first word in the eighth month of Darius's second year, October–November 520, two months after Haggai 1:1; the horses as an imperial-style patrol (Baldwin); colour symbolism debated, link with Rev 6 rejected; the man among the myrtles = the Angel of the LORD (1:11), "an Old Testament appearance of Jesus"; the four horns "likely" Babylon, Medo-Persia, Greece and Rome if read prophetically; the craftsmen are nations raised to judge the scatterers
